---
title: "Real Property Tax in Baltimore"
subtitle: "Flaws in the current SDAT assessments of land"
author: "Joshua Spokes"
---

```{r pull-city-data, cache = TRUE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(sf)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(gt)
library(webshot2)
library(ggplot2)
library(tmap)
library(tmaptools)
library(OpenStreetMap)

# I am so angry that this works
baltimore <- st_read("https://geodata.baltimorecity.gov/egis/rest/services/CityView/Realproperty_OB/FeatureServer/0/query?returnGeometry=true&where=1=1&outFields=*&f=geojson")

baltimore_valid <- st_make_valid(baltimore)

mutate(baltimore_valid,
       total_assessed_value = CURRLAND + CURRIMPR + LANDEXMP + IMPREXMP,
       area_acres = set_units(st_area(geometry), acres),
       area_ft_sq = set_units(st_area(geometry), ft^2),
       valueperacre = total_assessed_value / area_acres,
       landvaluepsf = round((CURRLAND + LANDEXMP) / area_ft_sq, digits = 2)) -> baltimore_areas

st_drop_geometry(baltimore_areas) -> baltimore_areas_no_geo
```

```{r initial analysis}
initial_analysis_sample = c("1783017A", "1783017", "1784040", "1784036",
                            "1784035", "1784034", "1784033", "1784032",
                            "1784031", "1784030", "1784029", "1784028",
                            "1784027", "1784026", "1784025", "1784024",
                            "1784023", "1784022", "1784021", "1784020",
                            "1784019", "1784018", "1784017", "1784016",
                            "1784061", "1784060", "1784059", "1784058",
                            "1784057", "1784056", "1784055", "1784054",
                            "1784053", "1784052")

filter(baltimore_areas_no_geo,
       PIN %in% initial_analysis_sample) |>
  drop_units() |>
  group_by(BLOCK) |>
  summarise("Value Per Acre ($/acre)" = sum(total_assessed_value) / sum(area_acres),
            "City Property Tax ($)" = sum(CITY_TAX),
            "Land Value PSF ($/sf)" = round(sum(CURRLAND) / sum(area_ft_sq), digits = 2)) |>
  t() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column() |>
  rename(" " = rowname,
         "Burger King/RoFo Block" = V1,
         "Patterson Bowling Block" = V2
         ) -> table_df

gt(table_df) |>
  fmt_number(decimals = 1,
             suffixing =  TRUE) |>
    cols_align(
    align = "center",  # Specify center alignment
    columns = everything()  # Apply to all columns
  ) |>
  gtsave("Images/initial_analysis_comparison.png")
```

```{r two-block-city}
filter(baltimore_areas,
       BLOCK %in% c("1783 ", "1784 ")) |>
  select(FULLADDR,
         total_assessed_value,
         area_ft_sq,
         area_acres,
         landvaluepsf,
         valueperacre
         ) ->  two_block_city

slice_max(two_block_city,
          landvaluepsf,
          n = 5
          ) |>
  st_buffer(dist = 2) -> highest_assessed_land

slice_min(two_block_city,
          landvaluepsf,
          n = 5
          ) |>
  arrange(desc(landvaluepsf)) -> lowest_assessed_land

tmap_mode("view")

two_block_city_map <- tm_basemap(leaflet::providers$Esri.WorldImagery) +
tm_shape(two_block_city) + 
   tm_fill(col = "gray", alpha = 0.2) +
tm_shape(lowest_assessed_land) +
  tm_borders(col = "red", lwd = 2) +
  tm_text("landvaluepsf", col = "white", bg.color = "black") +
tm_shape(highest_assessed_land) +
  tm_fill(col = "green", lwd = 2) +
  tm_text("landvaluepsf", col = "black", auto.placement = TRUE)

tmap_save(two_block_city_map, "Images/two_block_city.html")
```
